title: Service NSW GIPA application – Privacy Collection Notice
summary: This notice explains why Service NSW is collecting your personal information when you apply for a GIPA request.

more_info.text: Service NSW and DCS handle your personal information
you can access and seek correction of the information
privacy enquiries or complaints can be made
Read the Service NSW Privacy Management Plan and the DCS Privacy Management Plan for more information on how:
You can call Service NSW on 13 77 88.
Service NSW is located at 2-24 Rawson Place Sydney NSW 2000.

faqs.q: Why is Service NSW collecting my personal information?
faqs.a: Service NSW collects your personal information to process your GIPA application.

faqs.q: What types of personal information are collected?
faqs.a: The types of personal information collected are detailed in the notice.

faqs.q: How will my information be used and disclosed?
faqs.a: The notice explains how your information will be used and disclosed.

faqs.q: Am I required by law to provide this information?
faqs.a: The notice addresses whether you are required by law to provide the information.
